title: Mete
summary: METE, verb transitive [Latin metior; Heb. to measure.] To measure; to ascertain quantity, dimensions or capacity by any rule or standard. [Obsolescent.] METE, noun Measure; limit; boundary; used chief

inlines.v: METE, verb transitive [Latin metior; Heb. to measure.] To measure; to ascertain quantity, dimensions or capacity by any rule or standard. [Obsolescent.] METE, noun Measure; limit; boundary; used chiefly in the plural, in the phrase, metes and bounds.
